name: Fussa (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Fussa city emblem in purple: a broken ring enclosing a stylised pointed device.
history: Municipal flag of Fussa, a city in Tokyo; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 October 1960.

features.role: Fussa city emblem — a broken ring enclosing a stylised pointed device
